research_archive.description: Historical ALFRED as-of snapshot archive documented in repository; primary provider values not independently re-attested

limitations: Stage percentages measure completion of 6 documented project milestones, not model accuracy or validated index completeness.
One ALFRED ZIP archive supports three candidate node mappings; those mappings are not independent node stress scores.
No historical series or observations are fabricated or backfilled.
AICS=NA and predictive_skill=NA unless separate independent scientific gates pass.
